predecessors.v1: null passed; prospective power gate failed
predecessors.v2: IUT restored useful power but prospective component-size null gate failed

inferential_target.estimand: mean held-out directional gain over the frozen training-resampling process conditional on the frozen training source and over the declared validation population
inferential_target.compound_alternative: every required group x ordered information-step process mean exceeds the declared nonnegative tolerance

bootstrap_v3.resampling: pigeonhole bootstrap: resample R training-process draws with replacement and independently resample validation blocks with replacement

qualification_plan.null_gate: every component false-positive rate <= 0.05 + 2*sqrt(0.05*0.95/1000) in every predeclared scenario
qualification_plan.power_gate: terminal all-required-components power at 5 oracle cell SE >= 0.80 in every predeclared scenario
